paite: Pathian aw, hon hehpih inla, hon hehpih in; ka hinna nangmah ah ahong puklut ngal a, ahi, na khalim nuai ah ka bu ding, vangtahnate athen masiah.
heading: David La / Panpihna Dia Thumna Saul Kiang A Kipan Kokhuk A Ataimang Lai

paite: Pathian Tungnungpen ka sam ding, Pathian kei dia bangkim hon hihsakpa.
Hon valh khit tumpa'n ahon gensiat hun chiang in ama'n van a kipan in ahon sawl ding a, ahon hondam ding hi;Selah Pathian in azahngaihna leh athutak ahon sawlkhe ding.
Ka hinna humpinelkai lak ah a-om a; mi mei a kang lak ah ka lum a, mihing tate lak ah; huaite ha tei leh thal ahi a, alei uh namsau hiamtak ahi.
Pathian aw, nang van khen pek ah pahtawi in hong om in! Na thupina leitung tengteng tung ah hong om hen!
Ka khe awkna ding in len aphah ua; ka hinna akun kheikhei a, ka ma ah kokhuk atou ua; amau mah alaitak ah akia uhi. Selah
Ka lungtang akip ahi, Pathian aw, ka lungtang akip ahi; la ka sa ding a, ahi, phatna la ka sa ding hi.
Ka thupina, halh in; pekging leh kaihgingte aw, halh un; kei zingkhang in ka halh ding hi.
TOUPA aw, michih lak ah nang kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, namte lak ah nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
Na zahngaihna vante sun in athupi a, na thutak meipite sun in athupi ahi.
Pathian aw, nang vante khen pek ah pahtawi in omta in; na thupina leitung tengteng ah hong omta hen.
